description: Among Giselle's many odd talents, one stands head and shoulders above the rest—creating culinary delights the likes of which none in the known universe has ever seen before...or probably would want to, for that matter.Every Summoner that has had the dubious fortune to taste her cooking and has somehow lived to tell the tale speak of visions and experiences straight out of a madman's fevered dream. From technicolor tentacles slithering along the length of a cavernous floor to the steely glint of an unblinking eye set in the hilt of her knife, watching Giselle work her magic is like delving deeply into one of Grand Gaia's most enduring secrets regarding its alien visitor, and to embrace madness itself....Or is the experience highly subjective and personal? To the outside observer, the friendly administrator of the Orebus Special Inquiry only seems to be an amateur chef bustling over a few pots, pans, and powders. Surely, if Giselle's form had begun unravelling into a cosmic horror as she served up another helping of her strange stew, everyone at the Summoner's Guild would have noticed by now.In any case, you find yourself seated at the small wooden table. Giselle brandishes her curiously clean knife with a flourish and sets the bubbling bowl before you. What was that warning you heard from the wide-eyed Summoner you passed in the hall again? Your attention is brought back to Giselle's smiling face as she beams at you."Bon appetit, darling! ...And try not to mind the wiggling!"
summon: Now, now! Don't be shy!I've made enough for everyone!Take a seat and relax...
fusion: Ooh, this ingredient will work just fine!Never mind the ooze; it's perfectly normal, I assure you.
evolution: I daresay this is my finest work yet!Here you are, darling - eat up!
